scope: Seven existing affected-312 identities; no new frozen identity or definition. Existing prepared routes, all stronger canonical acceptance and historical Red qualification remain preserved. This packet is dated evidence, not a live backlog.

updater_ownership.effect: Existing Boot/Check/Prelaunch guards suppress independent updater payload ownership; they do not guard ordinary restart callers.

published_package.scope: Only selected embedded modules bound to previously Git-blob-verified tagged source; no player, original, helper, native session or gameplay executed.

restart_source_contract.windows_dispatch: Fused Windows branch calls WinApi.spawn then love.event.quit with no restart argument; main POKEPORT_LOOP_RESTART is not checked in this branch.
restart_source_contract.spawn_implementation: src/core/WinApi.lua:141-173 creates DETACHED_PROCESS + CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP, closes process/thread handles and returns. Its separate run function waits; restart calls spawn.
ordinary_callers: GBA exit: src/ui/game3/boot.lua:427-429 -> src/core/Game3.lua:566-569 -> main.lua:1090-1093 -> returnToLauncher:635-652
restart_source_contract.argument_boundary: --game prevents only the ordinary window-close return path; it does not fence Apply & Restart or the explicit GBA return path.
restart_source_contract.loop_flag_boundary: HostShell checks loopRestarts in the Android branch; it does not provide a fused-Windows no-successor guarantee.

core_lifetime_boundary.observation: Supervised game launch waits the original std::process::Child before collecting managed user data and finishing its session. Preparation tool supervision is a separate authority; its process-tree closure cannot be credited to game launch.
core_lifetime_boundary.required: Do not claim full-session managed fitting while an ordinary supported runtime path can leave a writing successor after original-child exit.

persistence_boundary.portable_supported: SaveData portableFs and CacheFs provide supported executable-adjacent paths for their own callers. No global relocation of the LÖVE save directory is established.
primary_evidence: src/core/SaveData.lua:58-64 explicitly distinguishes fixed OS LÖVE save directory from plain-IO portable filesystem
main.lua:295,310-312,644 reads/writes/removes relaunch_to_launcher.txt through love.filesystem rather than SaveData.persistenceFs
known_unqualified_current_red_deltas: the OS-profile relaunch marker and other non-portable-API writers
persistence_boundary.scope: These are precise evidenced gaps, not a complete qualified writer inventory. Extending a path list alone cannot relocate external writers, transfer populated ownership or close the successor lifetime.
persistence_boundary.route_alternative: The observed external marker defeats an all-private portable-profile assumption; it does not exclude NativePortable external-user-owned profile contracts. For a proposed Core-owned private profile, qualify every writer under that private coordinate contract. Alternatively assess the existing external-user-owned contract with exact compatibility, ownership, separate consent and unavailable-data-operation boundaries. Neither choice supplies full-session lifetime.

isolated_dispatch_check.scope: Actual embedded HostShell Lua with controlled environment/platform/fused probes and mocked WinApi spawn/quit; no native Windows process, player, original, helper, thread, filesystem mutation by module, network or gameplay; dispatch choice only, not native CreateProcess observation.

decision.current_action: Retain the delivered non-owning components; keep managed fitting open with the exact common upstream dependency. Do not create per-title supervisors, AppData adoption, source-hash bypasses or runtime repair engines.
decision.historical_red: #98 stays historically completed/qualified on its actual September evidence. Current v0.3.97 maintenance is separately unfinished under #2926/#2510; no old contract or populated data is rewritten.
decision.gen2_boundary: This seven-title observation adds no Gen2 completion, package qualification or inherited Red acceptance.

resume_conditions: Upstream-supported process-preserving/restart-wait contract or a separately qualified shared full-successor-session authority; verify ordinary mod restart and GBA return paths, not only normal Quit.

Select and qualify one complete profile contract: supported Core-owned private coordinates for every promised writer, or the existing external-user-owned alternative with exact compatibility/consent and unavailable managed-data operations. Preserve existing runtime/source/data roots and retained populated ownership.

Per-title exact legal source identities and runtime selection, private fresh setup, restart/close, interrupted maintenance/recovery and preserving operation evidence; retained populated scope changes remain held.
Independent non-writing review, all required exact-head contexts, guarded merge/readback and individual canonical reconciliation.
not_claimed: Native Windows/player/game/original/helper execution by this inspection
Actual CreateProcess behavior observed at runtime
Whole-package source-to-binary equivalence or complete runtime writer qualification
New gameplay, Supported, populated adoption, shrinking persistence scope or old-save compatibility
Permission to remap Road Rash64 or resolve any of the six retained Direct decisions
